use default

stepped(start: int, stop: int, step: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let value mut = start

    while (step > 0 /\ value <= stop) \/ (step < 0 /\ value >= stop) do
        yield value

        value = value + step
    od

let x = 5
let y = -5
let z = -2
let one = 1
let three = 3
let seven = 7

let ranges = [
    stepped(-three, 27, three),
    stepped(-seven, seven, x),
    stepped(555, 550 - y, one),
    stepped(22, -28, -three),
    stepped(1927, 1939, one),
    stepped(x, y, z),
    stepped(161051, 161051 + one, one)
]

let sum mut = 0

let product mut = 1

for range in ranges do
    for j in range do
        sum = sum + System.Math.abs(j)

        if System.Math.abs(product) < 134217728 /\ j != 0 then
